title: Biogeochemical provinces and how stable they are
query: Using the supplied CMEMS global biogeochemical reanalysis monthly oxygen, nitrate and chlorophyll for 1993-2020 off California and Oregon (30-48 N, 130-116 W), divide the region objectively into provinces that differ in their seasonal cycles and vertical structure. Justify the number of provinces, describe what distinguishes each, and determine how stable the provinces and their boundaries are to the method, to the variables and depths used and to the years chosen.
